title: The Journal App That Finished My Sentence Before I Wrote It
description:
A short fiction story about a new journaling app, and the moment I realized it wasn't guessing.

#shorts #shortstory #fiction

scenes.text: I downloaded a journal app that claims to finish your thoughts for you. I figured it was just clever autocomplete.
I typed, 'The thing I never told anyone is,' just to test it. It suggested the rest of the sentence before I could.
It was exactly right. Word for word, a secret I had never written down, never said out loud, not once.
I dug through the app's permissions at two in the morning, hands shaking, expecting something sinister.
What I found was almost worse. Years ago, I'd linked an old diary app to this one to 'back up my memories.' I'd forgotten completely.
It wasn't reading my mind. It had just been reading me, the whole time, because I gave it permission and never thought about it again.
